docs.text: The Great Lakes are incredible. This is from Pictured Rocks National Lakeshore. I can't take credit for the photo...just sharing.

I live in the heart of the Great Lakes, so my art is mostly inspired by them. These ocean like bodies of water are very special, as are the landscapes around them. It’s hard to explain, you just have to experience it 🌲
.
